mixed.m4a.text: Niandikie invoice ya Wanjiku Traders, three days za plumbing, elfu tano per day, due Friday.

swahili.m4a.text: Nataka kutuma invoice kwa Wanjiku Traders, shilingi elfu tano, ilipwe Ijumaa.

english.m4a.text: Write a receipt for Otieno Hardware, two bags of cement, one thousand five hundred shillings each.
